Key Concepts:
- The "Pipe" (RSS): Direct creator-to-consumer connection without algorithmic mediation.
- Elasticity: Respecting the "Cadence of Reality" rather than the "Cadence of Advertising," eliminating the "noise floor" of filler content.
- The Wiki (Knowledge as Revision): Moving away from static publication to continuous, collaborative verification.
- The "Expert Amateur": Decentralized, volunteer-driven knowledge creation outperforming centralized, commercial alternatives (e.g., Arch Linux Wiki).
